ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows a family of transistor output characteristic curves: the vertical axis is collector current I_C, unit mA; the horizontal axis is collector-emitter voltage U_CE, unit V. The curves are basically distributed horizontally, and are respectively labeled with different base currents I_B, such as 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 μA. In the figure, at the horizontal curve of I_C=2 mA, the corresponding curve is labeled I_B=20 μA; when U_CE=6 V, this point is still on this approximately horizontal curve. From the current amplification factor β=I_C/I_B, substituting I_C=2 mA=2000 μA, I_B=20 μA, obtains β=2000/20=100.

method.method_draft: First describe the plotted output characteristics: a family of nearly horizontal I_C curves versus U_CE labeled by different base currents I_B.
